findings.title: Hardcoded password
findings.explanation: A static rule identified a credential-like value in source. Anyone with repository access may be able to read it. The value is intentionally omitted from this report; review it privately to confirm.
findings.fix: Remove the literal, load the value from a deployment secret store, and rotate it if it was ever a real credential. Review repository history for previous exposure.

findings.title: Non-cryptographic randomness
findings.explanation: The standard random generator is not suitable for session identifiers or security tokens. Confirm whether the reported value crosses a security boundary. Non-security uses may be acceptable.
findings.fix: Use the secrets module for tokens. Keep ordinary random number generation only for simulation or other non-security uses.
